description: This file contains unit tests for the 'split' operations in TensorFlow Lite GPU delegate for Metal, utilizing the XCTest framework. It defines a test case class 'SplitTest' with multiple test methods that verify different split functionalities like channels, width, height, batch, and depth in GPU delegate implementation.

classes.name: SplitTest
classes.description: A XCTestCase class for testing various split operations in GPU delegate using Metal. Contains test methods that execute split tests and assert their success.
